about.title: A commerce-focused junior college built for competitive careers
paragraphs: CPE Junior College is part of CPE Educational Institutions, established in 2007. Affiliated to the Board of Intermediate Education, Andhra Pradesh, the college offers the MEC and CEC intermediate streams with integrated preparation for CA, CMA, IPMAT and CLAT.
Our approach is deliberately simple: teach fundamentals thoroughly, mentor every student personally, and keep career direction in view from the first year onward.
about.image_alt: Commerce classroom session at CPE Junior College

courses.title: Streams and competitive programmes
courses.description: Two intermediate streams, four career tracks — all taught under one roof.

items.title: Concept-First Teaching
items.description: Small, focused batches where fundamentals are taught until every student is genuinely clear.

items.title: Integrated Competitive Coaching
items.description: CA, CMA, IPMAT and CLAT preparation runs inside the college timetable — no second institute.

items.title: Mentoring & Parent Communication
items.description: Every student is mentored individually, and parents are kept informed of real progress.

items.title: Discipline With Care
items.description: A structured, respectful campus environment that keeps students consistent through two demanding years.

career_focus.title: Intermediate today, professional qualification tomorrow
career_focus.description: Every stream at CPE is mapped to a clear professional destination, so students know exactly what they are working toward.

items.title: Chartered Accountancy
items.description: ICAI Foundation groundwork built alongside intermediate accounting.

items.title: Cost & Management Accountancy
items.description: ICMAI-aligned costing and management accounting fundamentals.

items.title: Management (IPM)
items.description: Aptitude, verbal and reasoning training for IIM integrated programmes.

items.title: Law (CLAT)
items.description: Legal reasoning, comprehension and current affairs for National Law Universities.

people.name: Founder
people.bio: CPE was founded in 2007 with a simple conviction: disciplined teaching and genuine care can transform a student's future. Every classroom we run is built on that belief.

people.name: Management
people.bio: Our management works closely with faculty and parents to keep academic standards high, infrastructure reliable and student welfare at the centre of every decision.

people.name: Principal
people.bio: We focus on strong fundamentals, consistent mentoring and career awareness from the first year itself, so that students step into competitive examinations with confidence.

campus_life.title: Learning that continues beyond the classroom
campus_life.description: Workshops, seminars, group study sessions, commerce clubs and student-led activities give our students the confidence and communication skills that examinations alone cannot build.
